say:2:1360232001:1.text: As you arrive in the Land of Riches, Tasi instantly appears before you.
say:2:1360232001:1.source_cn: 你们来到了流金之地，塔西也第一时间出现在了你们眼前。

say:4:1360232003:1.text: Tasi, fancy seeing you again! Is Harak's seal still holding up?
say:4:1360232003:1.source_cn: 塔西，好久不见！哈拉克的封印没有问题吧？

say:5:1360232004:1.text: Everything's fine—I just checked and didn't notice any changes.
say:5:1360232004:1.source_cn: 嗯，我不久前才确认过，一切安好，没有任何变化。

say:6:1360232005:1.text: I did, nevertheless, catch the scent of a nightmare nearby.
say:6:1360232005:1.source_cn: 只是刚刚在附近闻到了一些噩梦的味道。

say:7:1360232006:1.text: So, is there a specific reason you ask about the seal?
say:7:1360232006:1.source_cn: 所以，你们为什么会来问这个？

say:8:1360232007:1.text: You brief Tasi on Berial's scheme and actions. She listens with a contemplative expression.
say:8:1360232007:1.source_cn: 你们向塔西讲述了贝利尔的阴谋和行径，塔西闻言，露出了若...

say:9:1360232008:1.text: My friends, you know why I thought of checking Harak's seal?
say:9:1360232008:1.source_cn: 朋友们，你们知道为什么我不久前才会确认哈拉克的封印吗？

say:10:1360232009:1.text: It's because I ran into you a few minutes ago and you said the exact same thing.
say:10:1360232009:1.source_cn: 因为就在刚刚，我才与你们相遇，并且回答了你们的问题。

say:11:1360232010:1.text: Berial beat us to it... Magister, let's use Dunlingr's bell right away!
say:11:1360232010:1.source_cn: 居然被抢先了……主人，快点用顿里尔大人的钟镇压吧！
say:11:1360232010:1.male: Berial beat us to it... Magister, let's use Dunlingr's bell right away!
say:11:1360232010:1.female: Berial beat us to it... Magister, let's use Dunlingr's bell right away!

narration:12:1360233001:1.text: Without further ado, you channel your magic into the clock.
narration:12:1360233001:1.male: Without further ado, you channel your magic into the clock.
narration:12:1360233001:1.female: Without further ado, you channel your magic into the clock.

narration:14:1360233002:2.text: Again, light shines from above following the clock's chime...
narration:14:1360233002:2.male: Again, light shines from above following the clock's chime...
narration:14:1360233002:2.female: Again, light shines from above following the clock's chime...

say:18:1360234001:2.text: As the ground nearby rumbles, Hypofiends lurking underneath are exposed...
say:18:1360234001:2.source_cn: 周围的地面涌动着，果然，魔物就潜藏在周围……

say:19:1360234002:1.source_cn: 不止如此，浮现出的，还有——

say:21:1360234003:1.text: The doppelgangers of Chippy and Hammie!

say:22:1360234004:1.text: I had no clue they were hiding here the whole time!

say:23:1360234005:1.source_cn: 居然敢变成漫漫的样子，过分！！！
